Schnittstelle BinaryTree<A>

Typparameter:
A - the type of elements held in the tree
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Mergeable<BinaryTree<A>>, Tree<A>, Visitable<Tree<A>>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
AVLTree, AVLTree.Leaf, AVLTree.Node, RedBlackTree, RedBlackTree.Leaf, RedBlackTree.Node
public interface BinaryTree<A> extends Tree<A>, Mergeable<BinaryTree<A>>

A specialised Tree representing a binary structure where each node has at most two children: left() and right().

Unlike the general Tree interface, a BinaryTree node typically carries a single element(). It also implements Mergeable to support merging two binary trees.
